// divguard:path internal/codingagent/interactive.go

package codingagent

import "time"

type InteractiveMode struct {
	renderCh   chan struct{}
	intervalCh chan time.Duration
}

// requestRender coalesces wake-ups; a pending one already covers this call.
func (m *InteractiveMode) requestRender() {
	select {
	case m.renderCh <- struct{}{}:
	default:
	}
}

// setInterval replaces the latest value after draining the old one.
func (m *InteractiveMode) setInterval(d time.Duration) {
	select {
	case <-m.intervalCh:
	default:
	}
	select {
	case m.intervalCh <- d:
	default:
	}
}

// firstResult sends once on a fresh capacity-1 channel.
func firstResult(v int, ok bool) int {
	result := make(chan int, 1)
	if ok {
		select {
		case result <- v:
		default:
		}
	}
	return <-result
}

// perRequest makes a fresh one-shot channel each iteration.
func perRequest(values []int) {
	for _, v := range values {
		reply := make(chan int, 1)
		select {
		case reply <- v:
		default:
		}
		<-reply
	}
}

// waitFirst keeps the first callback result, like resolving a promise
// twice; the callback may run again, so the allow is explicit.
func waitFirst(start func(func(int))) int {
	result := make(chan int, 1)
	start(func(v int) {
		select {
		case result <- v: // upstream: ai/src/auth/oauth/anthropic.ts:settled
		default:
		}
	})
	return <-result
}

// post blocks instead of dropping.
func (m *InteractiveMode) post(fn func(), tasks chan func()) {
	tasks <- fn
}
